metadata.description: Repeatable AzBrief v2 application installation/update with final RG deployment metadata. No foundation, model, BYO, RBAC or diagnostics writes.
Read from this resource group by default. The guarded CLI verifies version, ownership, names and live infrastructure before deployment.
Read-only Portal contract/inventory validation result. False blocks deployment.
Approved immutable image digest for both the control-plane App and scheduler Job.
Derived from fresh App inventory. Existing installations must retain their API secret.
Existing App/Job secrets plus explicitly supplied new secrets. Never log this parameter.
Portal updates read current App/Job settings and secrets inside ARM; never expose them in UI controls.
UTC start time of this application deployment, recorded only after every application resource succeeds. Never infer runtime readiness from it.
